title: Tenma Tsukasa — A Rush Of Excitement〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: We've finished putting away all the props.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much. We're just about done cleaning as well!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Asahi, would you two mind handling the rest?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? But we've finished cleaning and putting away everything...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Did something else come up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we seem to have run out of the flower confetti we were going to use for our show, and need to go buy some more.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that all? Then, I'll go with you! I'm sure you'll need someone to carry it.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Oh, mind if I tag along as well?
I'd like to see where you guys buy your supplies.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: There's also something that I'd like to buy.
Main Street
Stationery Store

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Let's see... Aha!
Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're getting... A notepad?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, it's nice to have one that fits in my pocket.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Not only that, the paper stays clean even when I get all sweaty after moving around a lot. It's very useful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can see why. I too carry around a notepad sometimes during practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it usually ends up a crumpled mess afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
You too, Tsukasa?!
Then, I really recommend that you get this!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, but you should take it out when doing a performance that involves being submerged in water. I remember ruining one that I'd just bought after forgetting I had it in my pocket.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Submerged in water?
I'm interested in what this show of yours was about...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll try using this notepad!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Awesome! It'll be great to see someone else using it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, I saw you using your notepad a few times during practice today. Can I ask what you like to write in it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to know as well!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: During practice, I usually just write acting notes in it.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: But for shows like this where I work with new people, I like to also jot down some things about them.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I mean, if you want to put on a good show, you need to know what your fellow actors' personalities and acting styles are like!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But you said, “During practice”...
Do you use it outside of practice as well?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, I try to write down anything that catches my attention or piques my interest while living life each day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: While living life each day...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes. Acting involves deliberately speaking and behaving in specific ways based on the roles we're assigned to play, right?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
But normal people don't act.
They do certain things subconsciously.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Tucking their hair behind their ear, touching their arms, moving their eyes up and down...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Those simple acts become the basis of people's personalities.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's why I've made it a habit to try and see all the little things that they do.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: But I have to be careful not to stare too much since doing that probably makes me look pretty weird!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even outside of practices, Asahi does whatever he can to improve his acting skills...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which explains why he's able to put on such incredibly realistic performances.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We always seem to learn so much from these conversations.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! A new discovery each time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I also take notes to make sure I don't forget about what I learn during practices, but I've been writing considerably more after we started practicing with you and the cast members of ArcLand, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's nice to hear that we've been helping.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You have! Still, I feel like we've been doing all the taking... If only we could give back somehow...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: But you already have.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
A lead with a wonderful aura and incredible acting range.
An actor with a vivid imagination and the ability to easily perform all these acrobatic stunts...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
A songstress with peerless singing skills and the ability to handle delicate stories and characters with ease.
And of course, a director who can conjure up unexpected stunts and effects for any genre!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Because you're all so interesting, practicing each day with you has been an absolute pleasure!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Hm? You don't seem to believe me.
But you can tell I'm right based on how my fellow cast members have been behaving. They all look like they've been having a lot of fun, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they have.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: How we're doing it doesn't matter. The fact is that we've been influencing each other in a positive manner over this past month.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, I'm looking forward to performing with all of you again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, the feeling is mutual!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I almost forgot that we're here to buy confetti. I didn't mean to let my own shopping get in the way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not a problem! The store just happens to be right over there.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, shall we?
